verdict: Organic presence is holding, but all three locations need paid channels restored.
narrative: Across Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision, all activity this period came entirely from Google Business Profile — a combined 404 actions over the last 28 days with zero paid spend on Meta or Google Ads. GBP performance is moving in different directions by location: Advance Grinding is up 45% week-over-week, while Forte Metals and O'Hare Precision are down 46% and 39% respectively, confirming that organic alone is an unstable foundation. Search visibility at O'Hare Precision also declined 23% in the past 7 days, adding pressure. Web tracking is being repaired across locations, which means website behaviour is under-reported this period. The immediate priority is clearing the CRM milestones that are past due and restoring paid channels so inbound lead flow is no longer dependent on organic signals alone.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
paid ad spend this period — Meta and Google Ads are inactive across all locations
GBP actions at O'Hare Precision this period, the highest of the three locations, though engagement is sliding week-over-week

watch_item.issue: GBP engagement is declining at two of three locations while paid channels remain completely dark, leaving lead flow with no backup source.
watch_item.fix: CRM contact lists are being finalised this week to enable outreach sequences, and site tracking is being repaired to restore full visibility — paid channel reactivation follows as the next scheduled step.
